concept: 后车组合威力——多路将杀
question_cn: 后和车是残局中超强的组合，再加上己方王的配合，通常会出现什么情况？
question_en: Queen and rook together form a super-powerful endgame combination. With the king joining in, what typically happens?

options.text_cn: 变成了规定死的套路，必须严格按固定步骤才能赢
options.text_en: It becomes a rigid formula — you must follow fixed steps to win

options.text_cn: 几乎每个局面都有多种将杀路线，可以按自己的思路赢
options.text_en: Almost every position has multiple mating paths — you can win your own way

options.text_cn: 王加入反而帮倒忙，后车自己行动更快
options.text_en: The king gets in the way — queen and rook are faster without it

options.text_cn: 后和车会互相挡路，三子反而难以配合
options.text_en: Queen and rook block each other, making three-piece coordination harder

explanation_cn: 后车王三子合力是残局中最强大的组合之一。正因为力量碾压性地强，大多数局面下走法众多都能赢——这就是探索多解的最佳入口。享受「随手一动就是将杀」的快感，体会组合威力！
explanation_en: Queen + rook + king is one of the most powerful endgame combinations. The overwhelming force means almost any reasonable move wins, giving you many mating paths to explore — enjoy discovering them all!
